newsitem.title: USA: Former Iowa governor, senator Hughes dies.
newsitem.headline: Former Iowa governor, senator Hughes dies.

text.p: Former three-term Iowa governor and U.S. Senator Harold Hughes has died, the Iowa governor's office said on Thursday. He was 75.
Hughes, who had suffered from emphysema and other health problems, died at his retirement home in Arizona.
"He was a strong and forceful speaker, someone who gained the respect of the people of Iowa and served Iowa with distinction," Gov. Terry Branstad said.
Hughes, a Democrat, was governor from 1963 to 1968, elected to three two-year terms. He served in the Senate from 1969 to 1974.

In later year Hughes, who overcame a drinking problem, operated alcoholic treatment centres. He was in the news in August when he was ordered to pay almost $15,000 in back alimony to his former wife, Eva.
